findings.text: §22 says the pass "rebuilds those tiers from the complete raw record with the existing full compaction" and "writes each rebuilt minute and hour file atomically over the installed one, a scratch file renamed onto the path", but the named existing full compaction writes its destination in place: `compact_record` (`serving_receipts.py:399`) calls `telemetry_store.compact_file` (`telemetry_store.py:811`), which ends in `write_rows` → `destination.write_text(...)` (`telemetry_store.py:808`) with no scratch file and no rename — so the atomic install §22 relies on does not exist, and the file that owns the write, `telemetry_store.py`, is absent from `srw-scheduled-retention`'s declared writes (line 860 lists only `telemetry_retention.py`, `telemetry_ingest.py`, `telemetry_index.py`, `node_probe.py` and their tests)
